    """Count the fraction of previous tokens where a specific condition was True."""
    # Use indices < i (strictly previous)
    prevs = rasp.Select(rasp.indices, rasp.indices, rasp.Comparison.LT)
    return rasp.Aggregate(prevs, bools, default=0).named("frac_prevs")

    bools_open = rasp.numerical(sop == open_token).named("bools_open")

    """Returns 1 if a set of parentheses are balanced, 0 else."""
    assert len(pairs) >= 0

    # Compute running balance of each type of parenthesis
    balances = []

        assert len(pair) == 2

            rasp.tokens, open_token=open_token, close_token=close_token

    select_last = rasp.Select(rasp.indices, length - 1, rasp.Comparison.EQ).named(
        "select_last"
    )
    all_zero = rasp.Map(lambda x: True, rasp.tokens)  # Start with all True
    for balance in balances:
        last_val = rasp.Aggregate(select_last, balance, default=0)
        is_zero = last_val == 0

    # If any negative anywhere, output 0s; else if all last values are zero, output 1s
    # Output must be a sequence of the same length
    # So, broadcast the result to all positions
    select_all = rasp.Select(rasp.indices, rasp.indices, rasp.Comparison.TRUE)
    not_has_neg = ~any_negative
    is_balanced = all_zero & not_has_neg
    # Broadcast to all positions
    return rasp.Aggregate(select_all, is_balanced, default=0).named("shuffle_dyck")
